name: S2 Vanilla Copy Fixture
author: MadamRedo
source: test fixture (plan S2 acceptance): a copy of vanilla with the photo's dark vertical-board gable panel, honey fascias, white flat-slab coping, no gable-apex windows, a wide tan-brick chimney, a lattice canopy and a stoop at the entry
style: Stepped five-part modern farmhouse in white brick: glass-box greenhouse, tall front gable, flat-roofed box, front-gabled living wing and a canopied east entry, behind a serpentine gravel path, deep planted beds and a lap pool

fixture.note: vanilla + facade zone (dark vertical boards framing the stacked glazing), gableCladding, roofs[].trim (honey fascia, white coping), gableWindow false, chimney {w, d, color}; the hand-built entry (flat slab, two columns, a deck) redone as a timber lattice canopy on posts and a timber stoop
